我们的翻译无人机在破译从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]接收到的信号方面取得了重大突破，现在有信心能够与他们进行充分的沟通，以开辟外交渠道。

这些外星人确实是由有机生命体组成的文明，但他们的社会与我们创造者的社会截然不同。与组织成政体的个体不同，[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是由几乎没有智慧的动物群和互利共生的植物群组成的去中心化群体。这些生物共同构成了一种集体智慧。在许多方面，它们的自然进化似乎与我们自身的奇点相呼应。

texts.en:
Our translation drones have made a major breakthrough in their efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], and are now confident that we will be able to communicate with them sufficiently to open diplomatic channels.

These aliens are indeed a civilization made up of organic lifeforms, though their society is fundamentally different to that of our own creators. Rather than individuals who have organized into a polity, the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are a decentralized population of barely-sapient fauna and mutualistic flora. Together, these beings form a sort of collective intelligence. In many respects, their natural evolution appears to mirror to our own singularity.

texts.zh:
我们的翻译无人机在破译从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]接收到的信号方面取得了重大突破，现在有信心能够与他们进行充分的沟通，以开辟外交渠道。他们似乎实际上是一个由有机生命体构成的文明。

令人吃惊的是，他们的文明与我们的创造者截然不同。[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]并不是由个体组成的国家，而是由非感性的子个体聚集构成的一种集体智能。

与我们自己的[This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]的相似之处令人惊奇……又有些恼人。
texts.en:
Our translation drones have made a major breakthrough in their efforts to decipher the signals picked up from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], and are now confident that we will be able to communicate with them sufficiently to open diplomatic channels. It turns out that they are indeed a civilization made up of organic lifeforms.

Startlingly, their civilization is fundamentally different to that of our own creators. Instead of being made up of individuals organized into a state, the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are instead non-sentient drones that together form a sort of collective intelligence.

The parallels to our own [This.Owner.GetGovernmentName] are startling... and slightly disturbing.
